projects.name: Medico
projects.tagline: One platform connecting patients, doctors, clinics and labs.
projects.description: A full-stack healthcare monorepo. Patients book care and carry their records on a React Native app, while doctors, clinics, labs and hospitals run their workflows from a Next.js dashboard — backed by Express, Prisma and PostgreSQL with role-based access throughout.

fr.tagline: Une plateforme reliant patients, médecins, cliniques et laboratoires.

ar.tagline: منصّة واحدة تربط المرضى والأطباء والعيادات والمخابر.

caseStudy.challenge: Healthcare in many regions is fragmented: patients juggle multiple apps to find doctors, book labs, manage records, and arrange transport. Providers (clinics, labs, doctors) operate in silos with no unified workflow tool. The goal was to build a single platform that connects patients, doctors, clinics, labs, and transport providers — with role-based access, real-time coordination, and a scalable backend.
caseStudy.approach:
Built as a Turborepo monorepo with three apps sharing a common backend:

- Backend — Node.js + Express + TypeScript, PostgreSQL via Prisma, Redis for caching/rate limiting, BullMQ for async jobs (notifications, PDF generation), S3 for file storage
- Mobile — React Native + Expo with role-based navigation (patient, doctor, clinic admin, lab admin, transport provider)
- Web — Next.js 14 admin dashboard for system oversight, verifications, audit logs, and finance

A polymorphic User model drives 7 distinct roles under one authentification system. Over 30 services handle domain logic (appointments, prescriptions, lab requests, payments, messaging, blood donation, emergency).
caseStudy.result:
A fully integrated healthcare platform with:
- End-to-end patient journey: search → book → consult → lab → prescription → records
- Multi-role provider tools for clinics, labs, and doctors
- Admin visibility across all operations (audit logs, analytics, support, finance)
- Production-ready infrastructure: JWT authentification, rate limiting, Prometheus metrics, structured logging

projects.name: OptiVision
projects.tagline: A vision laboratory — WebGL try-on and AI face analysis for eyewear.
projects.description: A dark-luxury optician platform that opens with a scroll-driven cinematic sequence — a WebGL iris, a vision tunnel, an AI face scan — before revealing virtual try-on over live webcam, face-shape analysis with tailored frame matches, an AI stylist quiz, and clinical dashboards for optometrists.

caseStudy.challenge: Buying glasses online is guesswork — people can't tell which frames suit their face, and most optician sites feel like spreadsheets.
caseStudy.approach: I built a vision laboratory: a scroll-driven WebGL intro (iris, vision tunnel, AI face scan), live-webcam virtual try-on, face-shape analysis that matches frames, and an AI stylist quiz — wrapped in dark-luxury motion, with optometrist dashboards behind it.
caseStudy.result: A cinematic prototype that turns frame selection into an experience, pairing real computer-vision try-on with clinical tooling.

fr.tagline: Un laboratoire de la vision — essayage WebGL et analyse du visage par IA.

ar.tagline: مختبرٌ للرؤية — تجربة نظارات بـ WebGL وتحليل للوجه بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

projects.name: ILMI
projects.tagline: An AI exam-prep arena where students duel to learn.
projects.description: A competition-driven learning platform for Algerian BEM and BAC students. Ranked duels score genuine thinking time rather than connection speed, an AI tutor stays strictly inside the official Ministry curriculum, and an AI coach forecasts exam scores using real coefficients — all wrapped in an Arabic, right-to-left 'Knowledge City' game world.

caseStudy.challenge: Algerian students grind for the BEM and BAC, yet ranked study apps reward fast fingers and internet speed — not real thinking. And generic AI tutors happily answer outside the syllabus.
caseStudy.approach: I designed a competitive 'Knowledge City' where duels score genuine reasoning time, an AI tutor hard-bounded to the official Ministry curriculum, and an AI coach that forecasts exam outcomes from real grading coefficients — Arabic-first and fully right-to-left.
caseStudy.result: A complete product architecture — five distinct AI roles, a curriculum knowledge base, and exam-coefficient modelling — built for the 2026 BEM & BAC cohorts.
